name: Sakuragaoka Rei
source:
The only daughter of the president of the Sakuragaoka Group's core enterprise.
Possesses striking beauty and exemplary academic performance. Serves as vice president of the student council. She holds a strong sense of justice and despises those who engage in underhanded deeds. Her personality leans sharp, which tends to divide those around her clearly into allies and adversaries. While she does not outwardly display it to any great degree, she is utterly smitten with her fiancé, Utagawa Keiichi.
